extension.summary: Watch cartoons from multiple public sources
extension.description: Cartoonio lets you browse and watch cartoons from multiple public sources, including MegaCartoons, TopCartoons, SuperCartoons, ToonTales, B98.TV, and FunnierMoments. Explore Latest Cartoons, All Cartoons A-Z, series, and searchable episodes with provider source selection, pagination, TMDB posters, metadata, artwork, and episode screenshots.
extension.disclaimer: This addon scrapes publicly available content from MegaCartoons.net. Use at your own risk.
extension.news:
v1.0.64 - A smoother Cartoonio
Browsing and performance - Load listing metadata concurrently while preserving display order. - Reuse merged episode catalogues for 15 minutes between season views; Refresh still fetches fresh listings. - Use scraped artwork before making extra TMDB artwork requests. - Load TMDB seasons concurrently and keep memory caches separate for each metadata language. - Reuse complete TMDB episode-matching catalogues for 15 minutes between views, retry incomplete responses, and index season episodes for faster repeated metadata lookups. - Recognise FunnierMoments series URLs for show-name and season matching. - Fix alternate-provider category routing and pagination, and restore TMDB-assisted search with canonical title matching. - Search additional episode providers concurrently and keep working results when a provider fails. - Overlap primary search, provider catalogues, episode searches and TMDB title discovery; preserve other results if the primary website fails. - Prepare search-result metadata concurrently while keeping display order, and skip redundant search metadata lookups when descriptions are off and artwork is already available.
Listings preferences - Add Alphabetical and Provider order sorting for Series and A-Z. Website results sort within each loaded page. - Keep Latest newest first, Search ordered by relevance, and season episodes in episode order. - Add Show episode descriptions; disabling it skips extra description requests in Latest and A-Z. - Add optional provider names beside episode titles while preserving the original metadata and playback-matching titles. - Apply configurable page sizes across Latest, A-Z, Search, Series and season episode lists. - Add Refresh this listing to listing context menus.
Settings and navigation - Add a themed settings panel with Providers, Playback, Metadata and Listings sections. - Stage changes until Apply; Cancel leaves saved values alone, and Reset section affects only the current section. - Add rounded option and category boxes, Enabled/Disabled switches, changed-setting markers, pending-change totals and live provider counts. - Match label size and vertical centring across focus states, and retain a subtle active-section marker while editing options. - Keep unfocused labels readable and dim settings whose metadata dependency is disabled. - Fix startup focus, sidebar/content/footer navigation, choice-list exits and Back navigation; remember the selected settings row. - Disable Apply when there are no changes and skip it during button navigation. - Support individual provider switches, preferred-source playback, metadata language choices and contextual help. - Mask personal API-key input and keep key values out of visible row properties. - Normalise legacy boolean values, detect rejected saves and attempt to restore previous values after a failed save. - Require TMDB metadata to be enabled before fetching episode screenshots.
Source picker - Correct short-list viewports so visible sources do not scroll out of view unnecessarily. - Use rounded source cards, compact format badges and a unified source-count heading; remove numbered squares. - Preserve episode artwork, the episode title and the gold focus accent. - Adapt format badges for multiple streams, and return to the selected provider with Sources or Back.
Tools and cache - Organise cache information and cleanup under Tools / Cache, with provider connection checks under Tools / Diagnostics. - Keep the Changelog menu name and support the previous Misc route for compatibility. - Add provider website connection checks and cache file/size information. - Restyle the Clear Cache prompt with a cache-scope label, settings-preservation message and Cancel selected by default. - Clear Cartoonio provider pages, merged listings, TMDB disk caches and relevant memory caches while preserving settings. - Add cleanup progress, removed-file counts, already-empty feedback and accurate failure notifications. - Continue cleanup when individual files cannot be removed, and fix empty-cache directory detection. - Reject invalid or redirected cleanup paths, close cache files reliably and avoid creating cache folders on read misses. - Avoid immediately refreshing and refilling a cleared cache; separate catalogue caches by provider selection and metadata language.
Changelog and shared design - Redesign the changelog with a persistent release sidebar and notes beside the selected version. - Show complete release rows, soft-gold version numbers, an inline CURRENT badge and per-release change counts. - Keep release titles separate from the notes and make Back return from reading to the release list. - Reformat all older releases with short titles, section headings and bullet points while preserving their history. - Standardise dialog buttons at 180 x 44 pixels, with rounded corners, consistent spacing and matching focus colours. - Add nine matching orange-and-gold icons for Tools and its submenus, each 256 x 256 pixels and under 150 KB.
Code organisation - Remove unused helper code and imports, stale compiled test files and obsolete development previews while retaining active regression tests and menu artwork. - Centralise provider registration, catalogue/search jobs, playback probes, cache namespaces and series navigation URLs. - Separate catalogue views, playback and routing from the plugin entry point. - Share dialog palette and button definitions, add a theme consistency checker and group regression tests by feature.
v1.0.63 - FunnierMoments joins Cartoonio
Sources and browsing - Add FunnierMoments to Latest, A-Z, Series, season episode menus, Search, and playback sources. - Include provider settings, preferred-source selection, and cache tools.
v1.0.61 - More reliable source selection
Playback and reliability - Fix source-picker initialisation and cleanup failures. - Handle malformed stream-format data and detect HLS streams correctly. - Continue playback when TMDB enrichment fails.
v1.0.60 - Cleaner MegaCartoons sources
Source selection - Remove duplicate streams with different labels or playback headers. - Preserve distinct media URLs and signed queries.
v1.0.59 - A more compact source picker
Design - Adapt the panel to the number of available sources. - Add spacious single-line rows and subtle gold focus accents.
v1.0.58 - Cartoonio's own source picker
Playback and design - Introduce a branded source picker with provider formats and stream selection. - Support remote navigation and safe cancellation.
v1.0.57 - Smoother catalogue browsing
Browsing and design - Add matching Search artwork. - Preserve merged catalogues while paging. - Correct alternate-provider category routing and pagination.
Reliability - Handle unavailable cache storage safely.
v1.0.56 - Search returns
Search and settings - Restore Search and add addon settings. - Fix pagination across merged search results.
Privacy - Remove API keys from TMDB error logs.
v1.0.55 - Complete series catalogues
Series and metadata - Collect all TopCartoons episode pages before grouping seasons. - Retry TMDB metadata after temporary request failures. - Respect the episode-screenshot setting in season listings.
v1.0.54 - Better series identification
Browsing and metadata - Stop breadcrumb links from identifying Home as an episode's series. - Preserve alternate-provider routing for search folders. - Skip invalid B98 series-category probes.
Settings - Avoid typed-boolean errors with legacy string settings.
v1.0.53 - Clearer playback diagnostics
Playback diagnostics - Log the episode, available and selected providers, media host, and stream type at normal log level. - Track cancellations and playback handoff with a shared request ID.
Privacy - Omit stream credentials, paths, query tokens, and headers from these diagnostic events.
v1.0.52 - More reliable browsing and playback
Browsing - Fix folder-listing crashes, double-decoded URL parameters, and repeated pagination segments. - Remove unrelated B98 entries from category views. - Add More Items navigation for merged Latest and A-Z results in batches of 20.
Playback - Complete Kodi playback callbacks when sources are unavailable or selection is cancelled. - Handle streams without quality labels.
v1.0.51 - Fresh menu artwork and cache tools
Design - Add matching cartoon artwork for Latest, A-Z, Series, and Tools, with each icon under 200 KB.
Cache tools - Improve clearing of provider pages, catalogues, and TMDB disk and memory caches. - Preserve settings and report success or failure accurately.
v1.0.50 - Correctly displayed titles
Browsing and metadata - Decode HTML entities so apostrophes, quotes, and ampersands display correctly.
v1.0.49 - More direct series navigation
Menus and browsing - Remove Search from the root menu. - Improve exact-show routing into provider season and episode views.
v1.0.48 - Better search results and pagination
Search - Improve TMDB-assisted search and prioritise exact matches. - Support multi-page search results.
Browsing - Show consistent item counts on pagination controls across catalogues.
v1.0.47 - Richer episode search results
Metadata and artwork - Add TMDB posters, artwork, and metadata to episode search results.
v1.0.46 - B98 episodes in Search
Search - Include matching playable B98.TV cartoons alongside results from existing providers.
v1.0.45 - B98.TV joins Cartoonio
Sources and browsing - Add B98.TV as a playable source. - Merge B98 cartoons into Latest and All Cartoons A-Z. - Preserve matching playback sources from existing providers.
v1.0.44 - Richer A-Z listings
Browsing and metadata - Add episode descriptions and metadata to All Cartoons A-Z. - Use 20-item pages for A-Z and Latest.
Menus and playback - Remove obsolete menu options and improve Kodi playback safety.
v1.0.43 - Cached pages and safer MP4 playback
Browsing - Add cached catalogue pagination and respect the configured items per page.
Playback - Harden direct MP4 playback across the remaining providers to reduce Stop and seek hangs.
v1.0.37 - One catalogue, multiple sources
Sources and browsing - Unify MegaCartoons, TopCartoons, SuperCartoons, and ToonTales catalogues. - Add cached parallel source checks, exact-title availability filtering, and direct playable streams. - Correct pagination and season grouping.
Metadata and artwork - Expand TMDB show, season, episode, poster, and alias matching.
v1.0.0 - Welcome to Cartoonio
Initial release - Add full MegaCartoons.net browsing and playback integration. - Include TMDB metadata.
